items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: Father Carter gave a concert for the school... Father Carter asked them, well, if he break anything on the drum, that he would pay for him.

ctx.x: Two years old. Can you tell us anything about your early life when you started out, which other bands you played with? You mentioned that trio in the theater. Yes, sir. And then who else did you start to play?

Well, Robichaux. I played my, the first time I played in a band of music, I played with Robichaux up at St. Catherine Hall. I was making my community then. Well, Father Carter gave a concert for the school, to raise my funds for the school up there, Tulane Avenue across from the Charity Hospital.
